segments.content:
Chapter 170: Who Is Actually Winning?

Watching Ying Chanxi speechlessly pick up the huge pile of 5-3 exercise books, looking frustrated and dejected, the people around couldn't help but snicker.

But everyone also noticed something.

Ying Chanxi, the top student in their grade, actually had a somewhat cute personality.

Before this, many people hadn't had much contact with Ying Chanxi, but they had all more or less heard rumors about her from classmates they knew.

Things like how she had dominated the top spot in her grade since junior high, how she took first place in the independent admissions for Fuyi High School by a landslide, and how she once even snatched first place in every single subject in a test.

Not only was she the class president of the advanced Class One, making all the other prodigies in Class One pale in comparison and accept her superiority wholeheartedly.

Now, she was not only the vice president of the student council, but her performance in the math competition was also said to be outstanding.

Although she was usually polite to others, she lacked the typical gentleness of most girls, instead displaying the air and confidence of an academic prodigy.

Many people didn't quite dare to strike up a conversation with her.

But at this very moment, what Ying Chanxi showed everyone was a coquettishly cute and innocent side, the youthful bloom of a girl her age, blossoming right before their eyes.

However, most people didn't realize that this side of Ying Chanxi, which was rarely seen by others, would only ever appear in front of Li Luo.

"I'm so jealous," Li Luo said with a sigh. "Only Ying Chanxi, the top student in the grade, could possibly draw the one and only special prize. I couldn't have drawn it even if I wanted to, I just don't have that kind of luck or fate."

"You, just shut up," Ying Chanxi glared at him angrily. "Hurry up and take your last draw. Let's see what you can get."

"I don't really care. I was just craving a bag of latiao anyway," Li Luo said as he reached into the raffle box, casually grabbed a slip of paper, and handed it to the student across from him.

The male student took the slip, unfolded it, and immediately raised his eyebrows, somewhat surprised. "First prize, one fountain pen."

"Huh?" Xu Youyu was surprised and leaned over to take a look. "It really is. There are only three in total, and no one had drawn one before."

"My luck's pretty good," Li Luo said, surprised. He took a very exquisite pen box from the student. "But it still can't compare to the luck of drawing the special prize."

"Would it kill you to say a few words less?" Ying Chanxi stared at him with narrowed, resentful eyes.

Yan Zhusheng, standing beside them, leaned over curiously and asked, "Can you open it?"

"Of course." In front of everyone, Li Luo lifted the lid of the box, revealing a very delicate fountain pen inside.

The entire pen was a deep blue, with a hint of black. Under the scattering sunlight, one could see specks like a starry sky.

Picking up the pen and turning it, the color would even shift from deep blue to light blue due to the light.

On the pen cap, the number 2014 was engraved in gold.

On the body of the pen was the auspicious New Year's phrase, "The sequence of years renews; all things are made new."

It was indeed worthy of being the first prize in the New Year's Gala raffle, looking exceptionally classy at first glance.

"Oh, right, you still haven't taken the pencil case you drew earlier," the student across from him reminded Li Luo. "Come over and pick one out yourself."

"Oh, okay." Li Luo put the lid back on the pen box, stepped away from the raffle table, and moved aside with Ying Chanxi and the others to make way for the people behind them.

Then, Li Luo walked over to the prize boxes and looked at the pile of pencil cases scattered about.

When they were younger, they used to use pencil boxes, the kind made of harder material.

Later, in junior and senior high school, they gradually switched from hard pencil boxes to these pencil cases, which were not afraid of being dropped.

Li Luo rummaged through them, then suddenly turned his head and asked Ying Chanxi, "Xixi, do you believe in the light?"

"Huh?" Ying Chanxi was stunned for a moment, then looked speechless. "What kind of nonsense are you spouting."

"Alright then, this one it is." From the numerous pencil cases, Li Luo pulled out one with Ultraman Tiga printed on it. He then unzipped the case, stuffed the pen box inside, and tossed it into Ying Chanxi's arms. "5-3 and a fountain pen, that fits your persona as the top student. This is for you."

Ying Chanxi blinked, not reacting at first. She looked down at the pencil case on top of the 5-3 books and the pen box inside, then it finally dawned on her. "For me?"

"You don't want it? If not, I'll give it to someone else."

"Who said I don't want it!" Ying Chanxi spun around abruptly, not giving him a chance to take it back. "You've already given it to me, there's no taking it back."

"Then you should at least give something in return, right?" Li Luo chuckled and pulled the three bags of latiao from her arms. "These are mine."

Ying Chanxi huffed, but she was actually extremely happy inside. The pile of 5-3 books in her arms didn't even feel heavy anymore as she walked lightly towards the school building. "I'm going to put these things back in the classroom first."

"We're heading back too, then." Li Luo, with Yan Zhusheng in tow, waved at Xu Youyu. "Senior, we're leaving now. You carry on."

"Bye-bye." Xu Youyu waved her hand, and then saw Li Luo toss a bag of latiao over, which hit her squarely on the chest and was caught perfectly, not even falling.

"Senior, a tribute to you."

"..." Xu Youyu speechlessly took the bag of latiao off her chest. "Are you crazy? Can't you just hand it over properly?"

"Ahem... my mistake." Li Luo gave an awkward laugh and quickly scurried away with Yan Zhusheng.

Leaving Xu Youyu at a loss for whether to laugh or cry. She looked at the latiao in her hand, then glanced at the large box full of latiao in the prize area next to her.

How should she put it...

As the president of the student council, if she really wanted to eat latiao, she could just grab a bag. There was no way they would run out, and any leftovers would be distributed among the students who helped out.

But she didn't usually eat this stuff, so naturally, she wouldn't just take one.

However, holding the bag of latiao that Li Luo had thrown at her, Xu Youyu subconsciously tore open the package and started to nibble on it.

By the time Li Luo and the others finished with the raffle, it was already after ten-thirty in the morning.

After taking the prizes back to the classroom, Ying Chanxi stayed in Class One to help.

Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng also picked up their instruments again and got busy in the Class Eight classroom.

It wasn't until the bell rang at eleven-thirty that everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

The morning's class games had come to a successful conclusion.

Everyone paired up and headed to the cafeteria for lunch.

After lunch, Li Luo saw that everyone had returned to the classroom and called on them to return their seats to their original positions.

When the bell for the lunch break rang, the students, feeling a bit tired, began to take their afternoon naps.

Of course, there were also guys like Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang, who had boundless energy with nowhere to release it, secretly looking at their phones under their desks.

Probably watching something again.

But perhaps because the novelty had worn off, Li Luo hadn't seen them discussing his book much recently.

They had probably gotten tired of chasing the updates and had moved on to favor some new darling.

Fortunately, Kong Junxiang was probably off somewhere being lovey-dovey with Teacher Ding Xiang right now and wouldn't be coming to inspect the classroom.

So Li Luo couldn't be bothered with them and prepared to take a nap himself.

But just as he put his head down, he felt his shoulder being poked twice.

Li Luo turned his head to see Yan Zhusheng opening the packaging of the two pillows she had drawn in the morning. She passed one, a light blue one, to him, and kept the pink one for herself.

"For you," Yan Zhusheng said. "This way we both have one."

"Thanks." Li Luo didn't stand on ceremony and accepted the pillow from her.

Then Yan Zhusheng took out her Bluetooth earbuds, put one in Li Luo's ear, and then put the other one in her own.

The two of them rested their heads on their respective pillows, facing each other on their desks. After a glance, they closed their eyes, listened to the soft music in their ears, and slowly drifted off to sleep.

When the bell signaling the end of the lunch break rang, Li Luo stretched in his seat and realized that having a pillow really made things much more comfortable.

Yan Zhusheng also put away the Bluetooth earbuds and then said, "It's time to go to the Rock and Roll Club."

"You go on ahead," Li Luo said, checking the time. It was already one-thirty in the afternoon.

The afternoon club activity time was from two o'clock to five-thirty, a total of three and a half hours, same as the morning.

The time between one-thirty and two was for the various clubs to prepare.

Since Li Luo had joined the Literature Club, the Basketball Club, and the Rock and Roll Club, he would be quite busy.

For the Basketball Club, they had enough people, so he didn't need to help.

But for the Literature Club, as the vice president, he still needed to go over and take charge of the situation.

In addition, the sparsely populated Rock and Roll Club also needed his help.

"I'll probably need to stay at the Literature Club's stall for about an hour," Li Luo said to Yan Zhusheng. "I'll go find you guys at the Rock and Roll Club at two-thirty."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded obediently, took the harmonica Li Luo gave her from her desk drawer, and put it in her pocket. "I'm off then."

"Mm." Li Luo nodded, and also walked out of the classroom. He soon ran into Ying Chanxi, who had come downstairs to find him, at the landing.

"Li Luo! Let's go." Ying Chanxi bounced over to Li Luo's side and patted his shoulder. "Time to go set up the stall."

"Why do you seem so happy?" Li Luo led her downstairs, rubbing his shoulder that was a little sore from her pat. "Why not take advantage of this excitement and learn to bark like a dog first."

"Get lost," Ying Chanxi huffed. "We agreed to talk about it when we get home."

The main reason she was in such a good mood was that Li Luo had given her the first-prize fountain pen.

At first, she had found the Ultraman Tiga pencil case a bit ugly.

But after thinking about how Li Luo had given both of his prizes to her, she found that the more she looked at the pencil case and the pen box inside during the lunch break, the more appealing they became.

So in the end, she put away the pencil case she usually used and switched to the Ultraman one. She even planned to go to the little shop at the school gate after school to see if they sold ink.

As for all the times Li Luo had deliberately tried to annoy her today, Ying Chanxi decided not to hold it against him for the time being.

"Let's go, don't dawdle." Ying Chanxi quickened her pace, taking the stairs two at a time. She reached the first floor ahead of him, turned around, and shouted at Li Luo, "After I'm done with the Literature Club, I have to go hang out with Xinyan."

"I know." Li Luo slowly walked down the stairs, looking at the vibrant young girl before him, her cute little ponytail swaying behind her head. He looked up at the sunlight and blue sky filtering through the treetops and let out a breath of stale air.

This kind of high school life was truly interesting.

"Hurry up, you're so slow."

"Walk slower, don't fall."

"Let's race to the sports field warehouse! The loser has to bark like a dog!"

"Childish. You think I don't know what you're plotting? Just you wait tonight."

"Are you scared?"

"Goading me won't work either."

"Hmph!"

(End of Chapter)
